title: ALMA Observations of the Submillimeter Dense Molecular Gas Tracers in the Luminous Type-1 Active Nucleus of NGC 7469
question: How are submillimeter dense gas tracers (HCN, HCO+, CS 4-3/7-6) distributed in NGC 7469, and do the line ratios at the AGN support the submm-HCN enhancement and constrain AGN heating effects?

data.sensitivity: line rms 0.55-0.58 mJy/beam at 20 km/s; continuum rms 0.09 mJy/beam

what.value: Radio, MIR and NIR nuclear fluxes for SED (4.9, 8.4, 14.9 GHz; 11.8, 18.7 um; J, H, K)

evidence.quote: 8.4 GHz and 14.9 GHz from (cite: 2010MNRAS.401.2599O), 11.8 $\mu$m and 18.7 $\mu$m from (cite: 2010MNRAS.402..879R)
is only as half as that at the CND of NGC 1097 (2.0$\pm$0.2; )
assuming HCN(4-3)/HCN(1-0) = 0.6$\pm$0.2 in the brightness temperature unit

what.value: HCN(1-0)-to-dense gas mass conversion factor of 10

evidence.quote: assuming a conversion factor from $L'_{\rm HCN(1-0)}$ to $M_{\rm dense}$ to be 10, which is derived for AGNs by (cite: 2008ApJ...677..262K)

what.value: APEX HCO+(4-3) flux for missing-flux check

evidence.quote: we recovered only 54$\pm$16 % of the HCO$^+$(4-3) flux measured by APEX ((cite: 2014ApJ...784L..31Z))

recipe.method: CASA CLEAN with natural weighting; uv-plane continuum subtraction; primary beam correction
Fit synchrotron power law to cm data, extrapolate to 860 um; compare LSB/USB fluxes
Spectra from single beam at positions A-D; Gaussian fits to get integrated intensities and ratios
MIRIAD MOMENT zeroth moment without clipping; 2D Gaussian fit to HCN map with Monte Carlo errors (10^3 realizations)

recipe.goal: Dense gas mass and dynamical mass
recipe.method: Convert L'HCN(4-3) to HCN(1-0), apply conversion factor 10; Keplerian thin-disk M_dyn
assumptions: HCN(4-3)/HCN(1-0)=0.6±0.2; conversion factor 10; i=45 deg; FWHM~200 km/s

recipe.method: 1D slab X-ray attenuation with photoelectric cross sections; compare X-ray and UV heating rates
assumptions: alpha=1.0, Ec=100 keV, 30% X-ray heating efficiency, G0=10^2.5

evidence.loc: A. The size of an XDR
evidence.quote: which is $r$ $\sim$ 42 pc in this case

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN mask, iteration count and cleaning region
spectral window to channel mapping and CASA clean spw/width settings
Exact apertures/regions for CND integration of luminosities
Which MIRIAD and CASA commands for Gaussian fitting of spectra
score_reason: Data identified and key settings given, but clean details and apertures missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single ALMA project, numeric line ratios and masses, reasonably simple recipe.
